card.name: Daily and every-day frequency words
card.fires_on: Words that say something repeats on a regular schedule, such as daily, every (night/minute), consecutive days or weeks, and 'in a row'. It fires on the frequency word itself.

modes.label: Daily / every
modes.description: The word daily or every marks repeated occurrence, often just after almost or a verb.
modes.example: The woman and her partner should be encouraged to have intercourse<< daily>>, beginning on the day prior to the

modes.label: Consecutive or in a row
modes.description: Time unit or 'row' completing a phrase about successive periods.
modes.example: This makes three months in a<< row>> — April, May, and June —
